description: Expedited ARQ data received on a link: EXPEDITED-DATA-ONLY D_PDUs are reassembled into a C_PDU, delivered once, and acknowledged with EXPEDITED-ACK-ONLY each time, including a copy after delivery.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 9 for ARQ. Link setup as cas/make-called-accept: at 2000 the peer 0.0.1.3 calls with an Ed4 PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST, our accept goes out at 52000, and when that transmission ends at 57550 the link is made with the 16-bit family (B-0213, B-0142) and cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 runs (B-0215). D_CONNECTION_MADE starts the expedited ARQ machine afresh as well (C-0755). The peer is recorded Ed4, so spare room in a last block takes a PADDING D_PDU when it fits (C-0367, C-1154). The peer's C_PDU is a DATA C_PDU from SAP 5 to SAP 9 with 'ping' (10 bytes: 00 00 59 40 00 00 70 69 6e 67). At 61000 the peer sends two EXPEDITED-DATA-ONLY (type 4) D_PDUs of its C_PDU ID 3 (C-1010): FSN 0 with C_PDU START and the first 4 bytes, and FSN 2 with C_PDU END and the last 3 bytes; FSN 1 (3 bytes) is lost. EOT 20 on both. IDLE(CONNECTED) goes to EXPEDITED-DATA(CONNECTED) (C-0662). The FSNs are from the expedited pool, apart from regular ARQ (C-0282); the C_PDU is incomplete, so nothing is delivered, and an EXPEDITED-ACK-ONLY (type 5) is owed (C-0277, C-1210). The burst ends at 62000: csma.vdcd_end to 71000, LBT rule 1, contention 12000 ms. At 83000 the type 5 goes: the layout of an ED3-ACK-ONLY with type 5 (C-0289, C-0291), RX LWE 1 and one SELECTIVE ACKS byte 0x01, whose first bit is FSN 2 (C-1210; Ed4 C.4.5.4); 13 bytes, EOT 10, then a PADDING (11 bytes, EOW 0, EOT 10) in the rest of the block. A type 5 is not an ACK-ONLY, so the fill does not copy it (C-1211). The C_PDU is still partly received, so the node stays in EXPEDITED-DATA(CONNECTED) (C-1212). At 96000 FSN 1 comes: the C_PDU is complete and goes to the CAS with D_EXPEDITED_UNIDATA_INDICATION (C-0702); it is a DATA C_PDU received by ARQ, so cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 stops (B-0215, B-0403 as C-1216 extends it), and the client on SAP 9 gets S_UNIDATA_INDICATION, transmission mode ARQ. At 151000 the type 5 carries RX LWE 3, one past the C_PDU's last FSN, and no bitmap (C-1210); 12 bytes plus a PADDING. Placing it ends the expedited exchange, so the node returns to IDLE(CONNECTED), since no regular ARQ D_PDU has flowed (C-0738, C-1212). At 161000 the peer sends FSN 2 again: back to EXPEDITED-DATA(CONNECTED), not delivered again, but acknowledged again with RX LWE 3 at 207000 (C-1210). Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20 for 1, 2 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133), so an EXPEDITED-DATA-ONLY is 18 bytes plus its segment, an EXPEDITED-ACK-ONLY 12 bytes plus its bitmap, a MANAGEMENT D_PDU with no extended bytes 13, a WARNING 12, a PADDING 11, a DATA-ONLY 19 bytes plus its segment and a DATA-ACK 22 bytes plus bitmap and segment. dts.ack_wait_ms 60000. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000 ms (K-0080). No ARQ data of ours goes, so dts.ack_wait never starts. The SIS soft link times are unset, so they are derived: sis.soft_link_idle and sis.soft_link_min_hold (called node only) three answer waits, sis.soft_link_max six; none falls due within the run, and the idle wait stops while an ARQ U_PDU is outstanding (A-0320, A-0321, A-0326).
